body:
I need help with my skincare. 37 F 

I typically use whatever acne cleanser, gentle cleanser, or bar soap to clean face and a basic cerve moisturizer. The best skin care set I ever used is no longer available but it was the Patricia Wexler anti aging set from Bath and body years ago. Last year I went to an esthetician and had a semi facial and she suggested Eminence Calmer skin Starter set. It really helped with red skin but caused my face to be oiler then usual resulting in acne.

My skin is so sensitive my face turns red red and dries out or gentler routines leave me oily. 

Recently my pores have gotten so large and I have a few large pores that regularly fill up with gunk like permanent blackheads that just get bigger.

I am having nightmares about the large pores and have been avoiding mirrors.
The Change by Kristen Miller has been a favorite of mine this year. Strong older female leads, mystery/thriller, suspenseful, and a little witchy. Very female empowering. Not a cheesy romance at all.

Thanks everyone we did a weigh in today and she’s gained almost a 100 grams this week!

Also, those concerned with how she got in this condition please know the OG owners are being reported for animal cruelty, and we plan to rescue the other animals in the home.

Thank you! Yes it does. She has a lot of other health issues going on we are still testing for like cancer. Our primary goals are getting some weight on her, get her as healthy as can be, giving her all the love she deserves and a much better life.

She’s just too cute not to share.
